Product Description

Woodwick® Trilogy Collection offers fragrance combinations, each creating its own, unique experience as the layers melt together!     Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Rich, masculine scent that actually changes as it burns
    The Trilogy – Fireside, Redwood & Sandalwood Clove candle is easily one of the best I’ve found for a warm, masculine scent. Each layer burns into the next, starting with that smoky “by the fire” vibe from Fireside, moving into the deep, slightly sweet wood of Redwood, and finishing with the smooth, spiced warmth of Sandalwood Clove. The wooden wick crackles like a real fire, subtle but satisfying and the scent fills the room without being overpowering. It’s clean, earthy, and relaxing, like a mix of fresh-cut wood. I light it in the evenings to unwind, and it pairs perfectly with a glass of whiskey or some quiet music. If you want a candle that feels grounded, mature, and genuinely cozy (without smelling like sugar or flowers), this one’s worth every penny.

    • Made with a premium blend of soy and paraffin wax

    Product Description

    Woodwick® Trilogy Collection offers fragrance combinations, each creating its own, unique experience as the layers melt together! All Woodwick® Trilogy Collection Candles feature the iconic wooden lid, and are available in Large Hourglass (4.0" x 7.0"), Medium Hourglass (3.88" x 4.5") and select fragrances in Ellipse Candles (7.5" x 4.75" x 3.63").
